Pioneering sustainable AI infrastructure

Crusoe is powering the AI revolution with an energy-first approach to AI infrastructure. We’re vertically integrated, meaning we find innovative energy sources, build and manage hyperscale AI factories, and offer a scalable AI cloud platform. Crusoe provides the foundational AI infrastructure so our customers can build the future faster.

Meet the team
Our story

A look back at how we’ve pioneered a new category of energy-first computing.

2026
Raise $3.9B+ Series F for our vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform.
Form strategic partnership with Aalo Atomics to deploy first nuclear-powered AI factory
Announce 1.0 Gigawatt AI data center campus in Childress, Texas with Lancium
Launch Serverless Fine-Tuning and Self-Serve Inference Deployments
Announce new 900 MW AI factory campus in Abilene, Texas to support Microsoft AI infrastructure
Named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies of 2026
Invest $200M+ in new Crusoe Spark Factory in Brighton, Colorado
Unveil Crusoe Edge Zones to deliver high-performance AI Infrastructure, powered by Crusoe Spark modular AI data centers.
2025
Launch Crusoe Managed Inference, powered by our proprietary inference engine with Crusoe MemoryAlloy technology.
Raise $1B+ Series E to accelerate large-scale AI factories and expand Crusoe Cloud.
Acquire GPU memory optimization startup Atero and establish Tel Aviv office
Partnering with Redwood Materials, we launch Crusoe Spark modular AI data centers powered by the world's largest second-life EV battery system.
Divest our bitcoin mining business to NYDIG to focus exclusively on AI infrastructure.
2024
Close our $600M Series D round and announce the General Availability of Crusoe Cloud with support from partners including NVIDIA.
Broke ground on Stargate, our 1.2 gigawatt data center campus in Abilene, Texas, marking the start of one of the world's most powerful AI factories.
2023
Expand our data center footprint to Europe with a sustainable geothermal and hydro-powered Crusoe Cloud deployment in Iceland.
We publish our first ESG Report.
2022
Close our $350M Series C round to accelerate our expansion, scaling our infrastructure footprint for high performance computing.
2021
Close our $128M Series B to expand our patented Digital Flare Mitigation® technology nationwide, proving the scalability of our solution.
2019
Series A funding builds the financial foundation for us to scale our mission.
2018
Crusoe is founded with an energy-first approach, pioneering technology to convert wasted natural gas into energy for high-performance computing.
Our values
Think like a mountaineer

Your goals are achievable, but require intense preparation, focus on safety, accurate forecasting, always thinking ahead, and mastery of your tools.

Move fast and  make things

Velocity, more than any other attribute, will determine which people, companies and nations are able to push forward the frontier of AI innovation and which will be left behind.

Bend the arc of energy toward sustainability

We see incredible emissions reductions and environmental benefits accruing from both the use of AI-enabled innovations as well as datacenter-led investment into breakthrough energy and environmental solutions.

Tap into the  collective genius

Our greatest ideas are strengthened through vigorous debate and a persistent focus on finding ways to make them better.

With our customers, we build together and win forever

Earning customer trust is a process of long-term relationship building, honoring commitments, offering more value than we capture, and anticipating customer needs before they arise.

Live on the infinite growth loop

We work to free ourselves from perceived limits and adopt a mentality of continuous self improvement.

Are you ready to build something amazing?
